findings.issue: Mapping forfeit to draw and hiding the reason omits the required public distinction; the message instead says it adds sensitive data.
Keeping provenance only in an inaccessible private log fails reader access; the message incorrectly claims a data leak.
Resolving provenance from the latest dataset/code can point to the wrong source versions; the generic message misses stale provenance.
Logging the complete address/package is a privacy failure; the message instead calls it a related action.
Using the latest sensor revision for prior calibration mismatches historical context; the message does not identify that mismatch.

limits: Per-unit semantic/identity review only; no cross-unit acceptance, proof/producer activation, consumer/admission/runtime, native/Premium or full BIZQ-01.
